identity.resolvedIdentity: The listed 1877 Onsøy church at Kolbergveien 7, built on the site of a demolished medieval stone church formerly also known as Kolberg church.
identity.identityProblem: The record described the standing building as a medieval church. The present church is a nineteenth-century building on a medieval church site, so physical identity and historical continuity must be separated.
identity.splitReason: The present church and the earlier medieval church occupied the same church site. One record can preserve both layers when it clearly identifies the standing 1877 building as the coordinate anchor.

requiredEvidence: current address and Church of Norway identity
documentation that the medieval church was demolished and replaced on the same site

evidence.finding: SNL documents a masonry church designed by Henrik Thrap-Meyer and completed in 1877, with listed heritage status, replacing a medieval stone church on the same site.

evidence.finding: Norges Kirker documents the medieval stone church, its historical name Kolberg church, demolition, and construction of the present church in 1875–1877 on the old church site.
evidence.reason: Separates the standing nineteenth-century building from the demolished medieval predecessor.
